messages:
Elena: quick personal update — Alex and I are tying the knot! :tada: We're having a very small backyard ceremony this Saturday (immediate family only). Would love to do a 10-minute office toast + snacks on Friday (Jun 13) around 3pm if that's cool with everyone. Alex is allergic to tree nuts.
Sam: OMG congrats!! :heart_eyes: count me in for snacks.
Rachael: massive congrats!! i'll bring a nut-free cake. any dietary prefs beyond that?
Elena: thank you!! nut-free cake is perfect. some colleagues are gluten-free — if you can label that, that'd help.
Noor: i can bring a fruit + cheese platter (labelled). will do GF options.
Maya: can help set up/clean at 2:30, and bring some fairy lights for ambience :sparkles:. also happy to take a few pics if wanted.
Alex: thanks all, really appreciate it. low-key is ideal for us.
People Ops: reminder from People Ops: small gatherings are fine in shared spaces. Please label allergens, avoid bringing items with unlabelled nuts, and clean the area after. If you'd like a communal card, we can order one and a small bouquet. DM People Ops by Wed EOD to confirm.
Elena: people ops — yes please on a card if you can. i'll DM the message.
Sam: should we put a tentative calendar block Fri 3

3:30 so teams know?
Elena: good idea. i'll create an event and mark it "short toast".
Rachael: cake ETA for drop-off — i'll bring to kitchen at 2:45.
Noor: fruit will be there by 2:40.
Maya: lights + plates at 2:30. i'll also tidy after.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Elena & Alex — Quick Office Toast" Fri Jun 13 15:00-15:30 (Conference Kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Elena: thank you everyone — feeling so loved! if you want to add a short note for the card, DM me or leave it in the comments on the calendar invite. see you Friday :blush:
